page_title: SHU 0-5 BHA | Sheffield Utd v Brighton 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Sheffield Utd will take a corner kick.
90+3' Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+3' Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Stuart Attwell ignores the protests.
90+2' It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
89' Simon Adingra (Brighton) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
85' 0 - 5 Goal! Simon Adingra (Brighton) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 0:5.
85' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
84' Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
81' It is time for a substitution. Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) is on for Danny Welbeck.
79' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) replacing James McAtee.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ben Osborn trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd).
79' Chris Wilder has decided to substitute Gustavo Hamer and he is replaced by Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd).
78' 0 - 4 It's in the back of the net! Pascal Gross plays it into the box, and Simon Adingra (Brighton) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 0:4.
76' The game has come to an end for Kaoru Mitoma. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ansu Fati (Brighton).
75' 0 - 3 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the left post of his own goal.
73' Jakub Moder (Brighton) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
69' What a miskick by Billy Gilmour (Brighton). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.

68' Evan Ferguson (Brighton) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
68' Pascal Gross (Brighton) is about to take a corner kick.
67' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) controls a cross inside the box and sends a low drive towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacts superbly to block his effort.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Facundo Buonanotte leaves the pitch and Evan Ferguson (Brighton) comes on.
66' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd). Stuart Attwell saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Brighton.
63' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. Yasser Larouci is replaced by Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd).
62' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Pascal Gross (Brighton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

61' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) went on a solo run, tricking his way past defenders, then produced an explosive blast from close range towards the left side of the goal. However, Wesley Foderingham showed all his agility, deflecting the ball onto the post! What a save!
60' The referee awards a corner and Pascal Gross (Brighton) goes over to take it.
59' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
58' Pascal Gross (Brighton) swings in a cross from the corner, but Wesley Foderingham reads it well and gathers the ball.
58' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Good work from Brighton as they win a corner.
57' Pascal Gross (Brighton) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
56' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
55' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails well wide of the left post.

54' Simon Adingra (Brighton) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Wesley Foderingham guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.

53' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Danny Welbeck was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
52' Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
51' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
49' Some great controlled play and passing from Brighton. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Sheffield Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Roberto De Zerbi makes a half-time substitution. Igor comes on in place of Adam Webster (Brighton).
46' Half-time substitution. Tariq Lamptey is replaced by Jakub Moder (Brighton).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+9' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+8' A quickly taken corner by Sheffield Utd.
45+8' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45+6' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
45+6' Pascal Gross (Brighton) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

45+6' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
45+5' Pascal Gross (Brighton) prepares to take a corner kick.
45+5' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Simon Adingra (Brighton). The linesman makes the right call and Brighton will have a corner.
45+3' Pascal Gross (Brighton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45+1' The goal is ruled out after the referee indicates that the VAR spotted Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) was offside!
45+1' Sheffield Utd score a goal, but referee Stuart Attwell has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) has a goal ruled out for offside!
44' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Sheffield Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brighton.
42' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) anticipates the cross from Tariq Lamptey, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
41' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) and Kaoru Mitoma combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
40' A great run from Simon Adingra (Brighton) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post.
37' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
36' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 22:78.
33' The linesman raises his flag. Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) is adjudged offside.

32' What a save from Wesley Foderingham! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
32' Simon Adingra (Brighton) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
30' Here is a change. William Osula is going off and Chris Wilder gives the last tactical orders to Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd).
29' Pascal Gross (Brighton) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
27' Simon Adingra (Brighton) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
27' Brighton keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
24' 0 - 2 Goal! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:2.
24' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham reacts superbly to deny him.
23' The opposition can't get near Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second.
22' The ball goes behind for a corner. Sheffield Utd will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! The corner comes over and Lewis Dunk flicks on with his head to Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
20' Pascal Gross (Brighton) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
19' The ball is cleared after Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
17' Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
16' The game is interrupted now, Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
13' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) has to leave the pitch!
12' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he’s going to review that incident from earlier. It could result in a red card, but for who as a number of players were involved?
12' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) for his blatant foul.
11' Pascal Gross (Brighton) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Wesley Foderingham comes off the line to clear the ball away.
9' Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
8' Half-chance! Simon Adingra (Brighton) plays a pass into the box, but Wesley Foderingham reacts well to snuff out the attack.
7' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
6' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brighton comes to nothing.
3' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Brighton.

2' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Bart Verbruggen has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brighton will have the kick-off.
Stuart Attwell was nominated as the referee for this game.
